title: Estate
description: What passes when you die (M2.7 step 3, D107, D109): who can be the heir past the family, and how the estate is settled by Michigan's rules, simplified. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

small.description: In cents: an estate up to this passes by affidavit, at no cost (Michigan's small-estate limit).

probate.description: Above the limit, probate costs this share of the estate, in whole percent (tune).

friend.description: The regard someone you know must hold for you to be a close friend who can carry on (tune).

pull.description: How far the heir's regard with the people you knew moves toward neutral, in whole percent: they knew you, not the heir (tune).
